build_standard_transformer_encoder: build a StandardTransformerEncoder with a list of TransformerEncoderLayer instances and optional layer normalization
create_transformer_encoder_layer_hook: create a TransformerEncoderLayerHook protocol function that inspects layer output and decides whether to continue encoding
register_layer_hook_on_encoder: register a layer hook on a TransformerEncoder to intercept and inspect each layer output during forward pass
run_transformer_encoder_forward: run the forward pass of a StandardTransformerEncoder on batched sequence tensors with a BatchLayout
review_layer_drop_training: review the StandardTransformerEncoder LayerDrop mechanism that randomly skips encoder layers during training with configurable probability
